sampling.rule: development first240 prior-registered companies by fixed rank; holdout first120 outside all prior registered samples and exclusions; no financial/outcome filtering

development_sampling: first 600 prior-registered companies in existing SHA256 ranking; expanded after origin-only inventory found maximum 93 candidate pairs in original 240, before recovery scoring

base_policy.review_note: 模板参数仅为初始敏感性情景，不是行业研究结论；使用前应审核适用范围和参数。
base_policy.nonfinancial_scope_review: 使用时替换为公司非金融经营范围的实际审核依据。
base_policy.bridge_review: 财报日股本/账面债务、不转股及2%额外稀释情景；附加索偿设0是假设，不证明无未披露义务。未分类金融资产不计入。

history.candidate_margin_range: 0 < mean <= 1; negative individual annual margins retained
history.chronology: all five completed FY available by origin Sep1; no use of target outcomes

scope: positive current TTM revenue, current adjusted EBIT <= 0; five complete prior FY; positive mean margin <= 1; selected only from origin data, not future recovery
rule: zero revenue growth; current margin + (five FY mean margin-current margin)*min(year/5,1); same former gradual schedule, explicitly implemented in research because production rejects current nonpositive EBIT
boundary: development loss-recovery input proxy only; maturity, business cycle, accounting comparability and full economic EBIT not established; not strict PIT or FCFF/DCF validation; policy unchanged; original reserved 120 untouched until development passes and holdout selection/code freeze
